purpose: Measure the exact static-feature last-readout delta-update Jacobian on held-out episodes.

interpretation.radial_eigenvalue: For output channel j, 1-(2 eta_j/d)||phi||^2. Its eigenvector is phi^T; hidden directions orthogonal to phi^T have eigenvalue 1.
interpretation.operator_norm: The W2 Jacobian is block diagonal over output columns: J_j=I-(2 eta_j/d)phi^T phi. Its exact spectral norm is max(1,max_j abs(radial_j)) for hidden width above one.
interpretation.fractions: nonpositive and amplified_channel fractions average over episodes and output channels; noncontractive_fraction averages the full Jacobian test over episodes.
interpretation.scope: This is an instantaneous W2 Jacobian diagnostic, not a global stability proof for the closed-loop policy.
